<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(frame):
    s={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','b','N') and n['pixels']==16:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']==12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            s['piece']=(min(rows)-1,max(rows)+1,min(cols)-1,max(cols)+1)
    return s
print('before', state(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after R1', state(current_frame), 'score', last_action_result.get('score'))
action(['RIGHT'])
print('after R2', state(current_frame), 'score', last_action_result.get('score'), 'lc', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
